name: Hishikari (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Hishikari town emblem in white: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Hishikari in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2008-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 November 1966.

features.role: Hishikari town emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring
